verdict_reason: The plants-backend context mirrors the other two plans as check-context-sync requires, but its URL env var is not supplied to the local or GitHub Actions ZAP daemon, and the unqualified 'backend' context name is now ambiguous.

todos.issue: The new plants-backend context reads ${ZAP_TRADE_IMPORTS_PLANTS_BACKEND_URL}, but only entrypoint.sh (CDP) exports it. The workspace's docker/stack/security.compose.yml passes the other five ZAP_* vars to the ZAP daemon with localhost defaults (lines 11-15) and not this one, on main and on origin/feat/EUDPA-713-organisation-scoped-notifications. The local stack and the GitHub Actions security scan therefore register this context with the literal placeholder as its URL, so traffic from the new @active plants spec (tests/plants/security/backend/organisation-scoped-notifications.spec.ts) to localhost:8091 falls outside every context. The workspace repo has no PR in this set.
todos.fix: Must: every environment that runs these ZAP plans gives the ZAP daemon a real URL for ZAP_TRADE_IMPORTS_PLANTS_BACKEND_URL, changed on the same branch name across repos. One way: add 'ZAP_TRADE_IMPORTS_PLANTS_BACKEND_URL: ${ZAP_TRADE_IMPORTS_PLANTS_BACKEND_URL:-http://localhost:8091}' to docker/stack/security.compose.yml on feat/EUDPA-713-organisation-scoped-notifications in the workspace and raise that PR alongside this one

todos.issue: With plants-backend added (line 63), the context named 'backend' (line 48) no longer says which backend it is: its URL is ZAP_TRADE_IMPORTS_ANIMALS_BACKEND_URL, and the address-book comment at lines 76-77 ('Same actuator surface as backend') now sits directly under the plants-backend block, so a reader cannot tell which of the two it means. One concept, one name: the env var already says animals.
todos.fix: Must: each backend context's name says which service it covers, and every comment and reference names one context unambiguously. One way: rename 'backend' to 'animals-backend' in all three plans (check-context-sync keeps them identical), in the activeScan job's 'context:' in automation-active.yaml and in ZAP_SCOPE_CONTEXTS in config/zap.ts, and make the address-book comment name animals-backend
